faqs.question: What is Minoxidil 10% Used for?
faqs.answer: Minoxidil 10% stimulates hair growth and delays the onset of male baldness. The use of minoxidil 10% regularly stimulates follicular cells, resulting in increased hair growth and decreased hair thinning. It acts as a vasodilator, dilating blood vessels and opening potassium channels. More oxygen, blood, and nutrients are able to reach the follicle, resulting in faster growth.

faqs.question: Is Using Minoxidil Harmful?
faqs.answer: No, using Minoxidil is not harmful. In fact, it is FDA-approved and safe to use. However, excessive use may rarely cause side effects. Use it as directed to achieve the best results.

faqs.question: Is Minoxidil Good for Hair?
faqs.answer: Yes, Minoxidil is good for hair. It functions as a vasodilator, which means that it expands blood vessels. During the anagen phase, expanded blood vessels cause hair follicles to feed the hair growth. It slows the rate at which hair thins out, giving the hair a thicker, more filled-out appearance.

faqs.question: How Do You Use Minoxidil 10% for Hair Growth?
faqs.answer: If you are using the Minoxidil 10% solution by ManMatters, remove the screw cap and the film. Put in the spray applicator. Spray the affected scalp area with the solution and spread it evenly with your fingertips. After using, wash your hands.

faqs.question: Is It Ok to Use Minoxidil Once a Day?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can use Minoxidil once a day. It is generally recommended to apply it twice daily, but this may vary based on individual needs and dosage. Always follow the recommended usage for best results.

faqs.question: Can You Leave Minoxidil on Overnight?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can leave minoxidil on overnight. For a perfect result of minoxidil's application, it is essential to leave it on for 4-8 hours. Hence, you can keep it on overnight while applying it just before bed.

faqs.question: How Long Can I Use Minoxidil?
faqs.answer: Ideally, you should use Minoxidil 10% for at least 4-5 months to see visible effects in hair growth and thickness.

faqs.question: Can I apply minoxidil 10% solution on my scalp after derma rolling? Do I need to wait 8-24 hours?
faqs.answer: You can apply the minoxidil 10% solution right after dermarolling. It's advised to use a roller with 0.5mm needles.

faqs.question: Does this Minoxidil 10 for men have any side effects?
faqs.answer: None! Absolutely none. Use our product safely without any side effects. This minoxidil 10% solution an alcohol-free formula, which means you won't experience itching or irritation.

faqs.question: Can I stop using the Minoxidil 10% Solution whenever I want?
faqs.answer: No, this is a hair treatment. Stopping it suddenly to try something new or due to any other reason might cause more hair thinning than normal.

faqs.question: Is this Minoxidil 10 percent water-based?
faqs.answer: Yes, this minoxidil 10% is a water-based solution.

faqs.question: I have started to notice that the colour of the Minoxidil 10% Solution is changing. Does it mean this has spoilt?
faqs.answer: This minoxidil 10% solution may change colour over time. However, it doesn't impact product efficacy or quality.

faqs.question: Should I wash my hair after applying the Minoxidil 10 percent?
faqs.answer: This is an overnight water-based solution which seeps into your scalp and doesn't leave any residue behind. Minoxidil 10% solution works on your scalp without looking greasy. You won't have to wash your hair everyday. If you wash your hair 2-3 times a week, please continue doing that while applying the solution as instructed.

faqs.question: Does this Minoxidil for hair lead to flakes?
faqs.answer: While our minoxidil 10 for men doesn't lead to flakes, it's possible that you may start to notice the flakes more after using it if you already have a flakes problem! We recommend using an anti-flaking shampoo simultaneously to keep the flakes in check!

faqs.question: Should I puncture a hole in the spray applicator?
faqs.answer: No. You just need to unscrew the cap, remove the protective film and place the spray. If it's a new pack, you need to pump 2-3 times for the liquid to come up

faqs.question: Does it make hair oily or greasy if applied to wet hair?
faqs.answer: Minoxidil 10% solution is oil free so, it will not make your hair greasy. However, we would recommend you to apply it on a clean scalp.

faqs.question: Can this be used post hair transplant?
faqs.answer: Each transplant is unique. It's important to understand how it applies to your specific situation.

faqs.question: Can I apply minoxidil on my scalp after derma rolling? Do I need to wait 8-24 hours?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can apply Minoxidil after derma rolling, but it's best to wait for about 30 minutes to an hour before applying. This allows your skin to calm down and minimizes irritation. There's no need to wait 8-24 hours, but immediate application can cause discomfort or increased sensitivity.

faqs.question: How should I use Minoxidil with a Derma Roller?
faqs.answer: To use Minoxidil with a derma roller, gently roll it over the affected areas once a week, then apply Minoxidil.
